label: Q-05
title: Documented 'double fee' mechanism on USDe/crvUSD pool 0xF55B is wrong (opposite-direction trades, not adverse price move); direct USDe/USDC route avoids the round trip
description: Documented 'double fee' mechanism on USDe/crvUSD pool 0xF55B is wrong (opposite-direction trades, not adverse price move); direct USDe/USDC route avoids the round trip
impact: Cents per harvest at current sizes; caller-side profitability only. The direct USDe/USDC pool 0x0295.. noted in MainnetRoutes avoids the round trip.
severityRationale: Wrong mechanism in the story-004/MainnetRoutes comment ('double fee'), costing cents per harvest; a route-choice and documentation note for the caller's economics. No security impact.
evidence: The documented 'double fee' on pool 0xF55B (USDe/crvUSD) is real but its stated mechanism is wrong. The live CurveAMMAdapter route for sUSDe->USDe is [sUSDe, 0x5706.., crvUSD, 0xF55B.., USDe], so the strategy skim BUYS USDe from 0xF55B (fork: pool USDe 134630.07 -> 134624.36, -5.707 USDe) and the harvester then SELLS the delivered 4.29 USDe back into the same pool (net -1.417). The trades are in opposite directions, so the first trade's price impact FAVOURS the second; the cost is two pool fees plus a needless crvUSD->USDe->crvUSD round trip, not adverse price movement. Both legs are atomic inside one tx, so no third party can insert between them.
